guidance: GuardDuty does not support custom detections. For organization-specific use cases, use Amazon Security Lake to centralize and normalize logs from multi-account AWS environments and third-party sources (CrowdStrike, Okta, Palo Alto, etc.) into an OCSF-compliant data lake. Connect a SIEM (Splunk, QRadar, etc.) or query directly with Athena. Alternatively, deploy an open-source SIEM on Amazon OpenSearch using the aws-samples CloudFormation template, which includes 2,200 Sigma rules out of the box.
how_to_check: Are custom threat detection use cases identified beyond GuardDuty? Are logs centralized across accounts via Security Lake or equivalent? Is a SIEM or query tool configured with custom correlation rules? Are third-party log sources ingested alongside AWS logs? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
